experimental_procedure: Ethyl (2E,4E,8E)-Undeca-2,4,8-trienoate (7) Solid sodium hydride (900 mg, 22 mmol) was washed with hexanes (310 mL). (2E,6E)-Nonadienal 6 (2.0 mL, 12.6 mmol) was added dropwise to the clear solution, stirred for 30 min at -30°C, allowed to warm to 10°C overnight, and then brought to room temperature and stirred for 1 h.
